gloss: deputy leader (of a group); vice-chief; second-in-command

definitions.gloss: the second-in-command of an organized group called a {団|だん}, such as a fan club, cheer squad, performing troupe, scout troop, or similar organization
definitions.explanation: Formed by attaching the prefix {副|ふく}- (vice-, deputy-) to {団長|だんちょう} (leader of a {団|だん}). A {団|だん} is a named, organized group — a troupe, troop, squad, regiment, fan club, cheering section, brass band, circus, martial arts group, or similar body. The {副団長|ふくだんちょう} supports the {団長|だんちょう} in running the group and takes charge in the leader's absence. The word is not usually used for business or political bodies, which take other "deputy" titles instead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{消防団|しょうぼうだん}→消防団：29795_shouboudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{副団長|ふくだんちょう}だ。
examples.english: My father is the deputy leader of the volunteer fire brigade.

examples.japanese: {副団長|ふくだんちょう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{団員|だんいん}→団員：23732_danin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: To pull the members together as deputy leader.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応援団|おうえんだん}→応援団：26792_ouendan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{副団長|ふくだんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{先頭|せんとう}→先頭：04374_sentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}って→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦{声援|せいえん}→声援：10153_seien⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: The deputy leader of the cheering squad stood at the front and led the cheers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{団長|だんちょう}→団長：12162_danchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{副団長|ふくだんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕切|しき}る→仕切る：04666_shikiru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Since the leader is away on a business trip, the deputy leader will run today's practice.

notes:
Composed of the prefix ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧- (vice-, deputy-) + ⟦{団長|だんちょう}→団長：12162_danchou⟧ (leader of a ⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧). Applies specifically to groups organized as a ⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧, which is a broader category than a club (⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧) or committee (⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧).

COMMON GROUPS WITH A {副団長|ふくだんちょう}:
- ⟦{消防団|しょうぼうだん}→消防団：29795_shouboudan⟧: volunteer fire brigade
- ⟦{応援団|おうえんだん}→応援団：26792_ouendan⟧: school/sports cheering squad
- {吹奏楽団|すいそうがくだん}: brass band, wind ensemble
- ⟦{劇団|げきだん}→劇団：20045_gekidan⟧: theatrical troupe
- ⟦{楽団|がくだん}→楽団：13181_gakudan⟧: musical ensemble, band
- {騎士団|きしだん}: order of knights (fantasy/history)
- ⟦ボーイスカウト→ボーイスカウト：27292_booisukauto⟧: boy scout troop

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {副団長|ふくだんちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as deputy leader
- {副団長|ふくだんちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take up the post of deputy leader
- {副団長|ふくだんちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appoint as deputy leader
- ⟦{団長|だんちょう}→団長：12162_danchou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{副団長|ふくだんちょう}: the leader and the deputy leader

RELATED ROLE TERMS:
- ⟦{団長|だんちょう}→団長：12162_danchou⟧: leader of a ⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧ — the head of any group organized as a ⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧.
- ⟦{副|ふく}{部長|ぶちょう}→副部長：23994_fukubuchou⟧: vice-club-president — used for groups organized as a ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (club), not a ⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧.
- ⟦{副会長|ふくかいちょう}→副会長：20469_fukukaichou⟧: vice-chairperson — used for groups organized around a ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (association, society).
- ⟦{副|ふく}キャプテン→副キャプテン：23377_fukukyaputen⟧ / ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧⟦{主将|しゅしょう}→主将：16187_shushou⟧: vice-captain — used for sports teams.

REGISTER:
Neutral and official-sounding. Appears on business cards, group rosters, and in news items about volunteer groups, fire brigades, student cheering squads, theater companies, and similar organizations.
